newsitem.title: USA: MTS sees 20 pct FY97 earnings increase.
newsitem.headline: MTS sees 20 pct FY97 earnings increase.

text.p: MTS Systems Corp said Monday its fiscal 1997 earnings could be up about 20 percent from a year ago, when the company reported earnings of $1.48 a share.

"Based on the strong first half and record backlog, and assuming our earnings continue to be adequately hedged against foreign currency fluctuations, we see earnings for the year increasing about 20 percent, possibly slightly higher," Don Sullivan, chief executive officer of the computer-based testing systems company said in a news release.
The company Monday reported net income of $4.6 million, or $0.50 a share, for the second quarter ended March 31, compared to $3.6 million, or $0.38 a share, a year ago.
Order backlog at the end of the second quarter was $132.7 million, compared to $127.7 million a year ago, the company said.
MTS shares closed unchanged at 20-1/2 Monday.
